description: Defines strict audit rules for presenting validated cultural claims to users as Turkish prose.

grounding_rules.requirement: Every story section containing factual/cultural text MUST reference at least one valid claim_id from the validated claims input.
Every citation in StoryPresentation MUST resolve to an existing EvidenceUnit and ResearchSourceDocument in the EvidencePack.
Story prose must strictly preserve the claim status: DOCUMENTED is presented as documented, CONTEXTUAL presents scope bounds, CONTESTED presents all sides, UNKNOWN states evidence is insufficient.
Story generator MUST NOT introduce new claims, external citations, or unvalidated statements not present in the validated claims input.
Story presentation MUST NOT declare carpet origin, dynasty, or age based solely on detected visual motif names.
Visual RGB/Lab colors or color names MUST NOT generate cultural symbolism or dye material claims without separate source evidence.
